name: UniFirst Corporation

corporate_actions.event: Definitive agreement to be acquired by Cintas: $155.00 cash + 0.7720 CTAS shares per UNF share (~$310/sh at CTAS $200.77 on 9-Mar-2026); EV ~$5.5bn. Croatti family entities (~2/3 of combined voting power) signed voting support agreement. UNF stopped guidance/calls.
UNF shareholders approved the merger at Special Meeting

FTC Second Request substantial compliance certified; Canadian Competition Bureau response completed 29-Sep-2026; parties agreed not to close before 11-Dec-2026 absent FTC closing letter; FTC staff concerns reported 27-Oct-2026. Not closed as of valuation date.

geography.fx_notes: US and Canada (plus small Europe/Latin America operations); INFERENCE US >90%.

ownership.controlling_holders: Croatti family (Class B shares, ~2/3 of combined voting power)
ownership.remuneration_notes: Change-of-control benefits flagged by plaintiff firms

A.rationale: Not scored: G6 = A (pending agreed takeover).

sector_specific.deal_break_risk: FTC review ongoing; if blocked, UNF reverts to a standalone ~5% EBIT margin, family-controlled operator (would need re-scoring).

gates.notes: G6 = A: agreed cash-and-share takeover by Cintas approved by shareholders; awaiting FTC/Canadian clearance (earliest close 11-Dec-2026). Price is largely set by CTAS share price + $155 cash - merger-arbitrage, not a compounding investment. Provider net cash (-$111m).

bull_points: Deal consideration floor: $155 cash + 0.772 CTAS per share.
bear_points: FTC could block or require divestitures; standalone UNF has ~5% EBIT margins.
Value tied to CTAS share price via the stock component.
Family control limits standalone strategic options.
